d: Nawazuddin Siddiqui is an Indian film actor who has appeared in some of Bollywood's major films including, Black Friday (2004), New York, Peepli Live , Kahani, Gangs of Wasseypur, Gangs of Wasseypur Part -2, Kahaani, Talaash, The Lunchbox, Kick, Badlapur, Bajrangi Bhaijaan, Raman Raghav 2.0, Haraamkhor, Raees, Mom, Munna Michael, Genius, Manto, Thackery, Photograph. And who can miss the famous web series Sacred Games 1 and Sacred Games 2
